bio.text: Anna Caballero represents California's 14th Senate District; according to her Senate website, she returned to the Legislature in 2016 when she was elected to the state's 12th Senate District, and she now serves the 14th after redistricting.
She was elected the first woman mayor of Salinas in 1998 and was elected to the 28th Assembly District in 2006. In 2011, Governor Jerry Brown appointed her to his cabinet.

Caballero was born in Arizona to a family of copper miners, completed her undergraduate studies at UC San Diego and earned a law degree from UCLA, and began her legal career with California Rural Legal Assistance.
